Planície de inundação do Rio dos Sinos com diferentes tempos de retorno. Modelagem hidrodinâmica da Bacia Hidrográfica do Rio dos Sinos, contendo os polígonos da mancha de inundação para o tempo de retorno de cem anos. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Downloadable Data, Planície de Inundação, Mancha de Inundação, Tempo de Retorno, TR 100. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
